headline: Capacity expansion nearing fruition; growth set to accelerate

highlights: Management expects the installed capacity is to support an annual revenue run rate of over ₹1,300 crore by FY28-end, with revenue ramp-up expected from Q4FY27E and full utilisation by H1FY28E.
The existing business continues to benefit from strong global demand, with H1FY27 Energy & Oil and Gas and Aerospace & Defence revenues growing 28.5% and 28.3%, respectively.
Despite carrying costs associated with newly commissioned facilities, EBITDA margin improved 150 bps YoY to 37.5% in Q2FY27, supported by operating leverage, local sourcing and backward integration.
Management expects the largely established cost base to be absorbed as revenue ramps up, supporting further profitability improvement.
valuation: Rating and Target Price : • With healthy order-backlog, robust pipeline and improving execution led by increasing indigenisation, we believe that AEL provides strong earnings visibility.
Multiple delta qualifications are currently underway across customer facilities.
ICICI Direct assigns ratings to its stocks according to their notional target price vs. current market price and then categorizes them as Buy, Hold, Reduce and Sell.
watch: The company currently caters to less than 2% of the wallet share of its customers, providing scope to increase participation through additional product qualifications and higher production volumes. • The company is evaluating further growth opportunities through selective acquisitions, manufacturing of larger components, full-stack production and co-location with key OEMs.
Investments in securities market are subject to market risks.
